alternative_fix_sites: trellis/graph.py::install_order (any ready queue that always yields the alphabetically first ready package, e.g. a heap or re-sorting)
notes: Packages that become ready during the topological sort are appended to the ready queue instead of being inserted in alphabetical order, so a package that becomes ready late can be installed after alphabetically later packages that were ready earlier. The order is still a valid topological order, so only the documented tie-break is violated. Chains and graphs whose late-ready packages sort last are unaffected (public test).
